views.text: HERE TO HELP Contact ChurchOS Support Church administrators can use the in-app chat to get help with ChurchOS or report a problem. Administrator live chat Use the floating chat bubble for a quick question. If the team is offline, leave a message and a reply email in the widget. Open support chat For a new chat session, open the widget menu and choose “End this chat session”, then start another chat. Previous conversation history may remain visible. Your church administrator manages role assignments, location access and church settings. ChurchOS Support can help investigate product issues; contacting support does not change your account permissions.
